name: Ethiopia (1987–1991)
description: A horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and red charged at the centre with the emblem of the People's Democratic Republic of Ethiopia: a cogwheel and a rising sun within a wreath beneath a red star.
history: Flag of the People's Democratic Republic of Ethiopia under Mengistu (1987–1991).

features.role: emblem with cogwheel, sun, wreath and red star
